session_rules.model_binding: The first request binds a session to its explicit model or the configured default.
session_rules.parallelism: Requests in one session are serialized; independent sessions may run concurrently.

control_plane_v1.authentication: Disabled unless a server-side control-plane token is configured.
control_plane_v1.sessions: The server issues session IDs and binds each to tenant, principal, Agent version, and model.
control_plane_v1.runs: Runs are durable, idempotent per tenant/idempotency key, and expose queued/leased/running/terminal state.
control_plane_v1.events: SSE events have monotonically increasing IDs and support Last-Event-ID replay.
